replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: on the driving and waiting itself, the record does not support your account. Your driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-00207) puts him inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence at Blk 682 from 06:41:10 and holding position there without a break for 507 seconds — well past the 300-second minimum — before he cancelled at 06:49:37 with the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. Your own device trace places you about 1.9 km from the pin for the whole window, with no fix inside the 100 m presence radius, and the chat log (EV-CHAT-00207) holds no message from you. So 'I did come down a few minutes late' is not borne out, and on POL-NS-01 alone the $4.00 would stand. The reason it does not simply stand is your driver's own record: EV-DPROF-00207 trips POL-NS-07's anti-farming guard on both limbs — 7 no-show terminations in 30 days (the bar is 4 or more) and 7 against 61 completed trips, or 11.5%, above the 8% rate limb. Where that check trips, POL-NS-07 withholds the driver's compensation (otherwise $3.20, 80% of $4.00) and sends the case to POL-NS-09. Escalation is terminal: no money moves now, the $4.00 stays on hold at PENDING rather than being collected or refunded, and the packet instructs the reviewer to refund the fee to you in full — which is the outcome you pressed for.

To the driver: every merits finding runs your way and is accepted. POL-NS-01's four limbs are all met (arrival event 06:41:20; in-geofence from 06:41:10; 507 s continuous dwell; termination at 06:49:37 with RIDER_NO_SHOW, 207 s after the clock elapsed). POL-NS-02's 52 qualifying in-radius fixes easily clear the three-fix test. POL-NS-05 finds no false marker (your marker landed on a qualifying fix, dwell starting 10 s earlier). POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall, so the full-refund route there is not engaged. POL-NS-03 cannot apply because you stopped inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: she sent no locating message, and her own track affirmatively fails limb (c). The fare line carries no POL-NS-08(d) defect — $4.00 is the greater of the STANDARD zone fee and the RYDE_X tier fee. But the anti-farming pattern on your trailing-30-day record is a clause-mandated escalation, not a personal finding, and a human reviewer will assess it.

The trigger is POL-NS-09(d). The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00207-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) plays no part: your hold was one unbroken in-geofence run, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation was never needed. No artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired — the driver profile, GPS trace and trip record are all weight 1.0 — so the confidence cap is 1.0 and confidence is stated at 0.90.
referrals: POL-NS-07 anti-farming check: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full. The fee is held at PENDING and is neither collected nor refunded by the automated pipeline while review is pending.
